_status_explanation: P0 ships this file as SEED, not authoritative. The principle below describes how rotation SHOULD work; mc-cli rotate (P1) MUST gate every credential through validate_credential before treating it as transactionally complete. Callers MUST NOT assume that 'no entry' means 'no consumer' — it means 'not yet registered'. Adding a new consumer of a registered credential without listing it here is a lint error; using a credential whose entry fails validate_credential for rotation is a runtime error.
principle: When rotating any credential, EVERY listed consumer must be updated in the same transaction. Adding a new consumer of a known credential without registering it here is a lint error.
rotation_command_template: mc-cli rotate <CRED_NAME>  # P1 — iterates consumers[], runs each rewrite_command, verifies each post-rotation health check. REFUSES TO RUN if validate_credential(<CRED_NAME>) fails.

validation_rules.must_have_canonical: Every entry must have a canonical source.
validation_rules.must_have_health_check: Every entry must have post_rotation_health_check OR every consumer must have its own.
validation_rules.no_orphan_consumers: If a consumer's path doesn't exist, mark it _planned: true or remove it.
validation_rules.host_required_when_remote: Any consumer not on Mac must have host field set.

validate_credential.rule: Before mc-cli rotate operates on a credential, it MUST run this validation against that credential's entry. If validation fails, refuse to rotate and surface the specific failure to the operator.

checks.rationale: A planned consumer is a known gap — rotating now would skip it and re-create the 2026-05-02 silent-failure pattern.

checks.fail_if: any string value contains '<TODO', 'TODO:', 'TODO-', '<...>', or matches /^\.\.\. /
checks.rationale: Placeholders mean we don't know what the consumer is yet. Rotation can't be transactional with unknown consumers.

checks.fail_if: this credential's name appears in the top-level 'todo' array
checks.rationale: The top-level todo[] is the explicit unresolved-questions list per credential; rotating a credential listed there is rotating with known unresolved gaps.

checks.fail_if: any consumer.path does not start with '(none' AND does not exist on its declared host
checks.rationale: Path missing means rewrite_command will fail mid-rotation, leaving partial state.

checks.fail_if: any consumer.host is set but the host is unreachable via ssh / not in ~/.ssh/config
checks.rationale: Cross-host rotation requires the host to be reachable AT ROTATION TIME.
